crash_replay.accepted_deterministic_proof: Plan0023-C06 result-staged and between-lanes same-tick replay proof

execution.command_shape: installed last30days-service tick enqueue with the exact accepted interval and default schedule identity
execution.monitoring: read-only tick and database inspection during and after the single synchronous runner

hard_stops: installed version, runtime manifest, readiness, schema, integrity, rollback identity, config file digest, sanitized config digest, or tick identity differs
any existing tick, queued or running attempt, enabled collection specification, enabled timer or schedule, or Guacamole lease appears before enqueue
provider or resource admission differs from the accepted sanitized preflight
a second attempt, retry, paid fallback, model call, or any per-lane or aggregate ceiling breach is attempted
a source-local condition is misclassified as a global success or a global integrity condition is misclassified as source-local
an incident is missing its protected rendered-page evidence when the provider supplied a problematic browser page
incident notification does not follow configured sequential primary-then-fallback semantics or sends without an incident
human observation is requested without stopping at the separate Guacamole acknowledgment gate
the process crashes, durable state cannot be reconstructed, snapshot promotion is non-terminal, or another enqueue would be required
a timer, schedule, push, publication, release, real rollback, or user-config mutation would be required

incidents.guacamole: not_authorized; stop for a separate operator acknowledgment and observation gate
incidents.human_link_requirement: only an external agent-browser Guacamole URL after a separately authorized lease; never a local link
incidents.notification_scope_if_live_packet_is_app: send only for a durable incident, using configured sequential primary then fallback
incidents.problem_page_evidence: protected screenshot and rendered-page artifact, available through governed artifact retrieval

postflight: read the terminal tick receipt and reconstruct tick, lane, stage, provider, budget, event, incident, artifact, derivative, and snapshot joins
prove every lane has exactly one truthful terminal and actual budgets remain within the packet ceilings
prove protected problematic-page artifacts and sequential notification outcomes for every incident that occurred
prove raw-first evidence, OCR, semantic sidecards, catalog entries, access metadata, lexical projection, semantic projection, and terminal snapshot relationships are internally consistent
prove complete or complete_degraded coverage and freshness metadata matches actual source-local outcomes
prove database and active-index integrity and preserve the installed rollback identity
prove zero enabled specifications, schedules, timers, unacknowledged Guacamole leases, paid calls, pushes, publications, and releases
obtain independent terminal receipt review before Plan 0023 can close

privacy.repo_particulars: digests, counts, opaque durable identities, safe adapter behavior, and source-authority references only

review.allowed_actions: read-only repository, installed-state, and sanitized-receipt inspection
review.required_result: terminal_pass or terminal_fail before operator approval may be requested
